Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor [n14300] (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kw motor.
Our latest forecast for part:350011 grows +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09).
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
We commit to a binding volume of 6,110 pcs per year over 12 months.
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your message.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €373.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.
For your information:
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We have incorporated your increased volume forecast into our calculation and can offer a revised price of €369.76.
As you indicated a willingness to pay faster for a better price, we have maintained our standard 30-day payment terms; extending to 90 days would necessitate a higher unit price.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €369.76 per unit.
Should you require further information, please let us know.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your e-mail, which we have reviewed internally.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €372.87 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel.
For your information:
We acknowledge your binding volume commitment of 6,110 pieces and value our continued cooperation.
Taking up your offer to pay faster in exchange for a better price, we have adjusted the payment terms to 30 days to provide a reduced unit price of €368.76.
We believe this aligns with your goals and offers the best value for your purchasing requirements.
Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.
Should you require further information, please let us know.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your e-mail, which we have reviewed internally.
We can accept your terms and await your order.
Our terms: a price of €361.28 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION.
Please note:
We have already taken that volume change data into account.
We agree to your proposal to include the CU-NOTATION index clause, which removes the copper price risk from our calculation and lowers the base price.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
Should you require further information, please let us know.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing
